ja546:1.1: Paṇḍu kisiyāsi dubbalā, vaṇṇarūpaṃ na tav' edisaṃ pure, Vimale akkhāhi pucchitā: kīdisī tuyhaṃ sarīravedanā ti.
ja546:2.1: Dhammo manujesu mātinaṃ dohaḷo nāma janinda vuccati, dhammāhaṭaṃ nāgakuñjara Vidhurassa haday' ābhipatthaye ti.
ja546:3.1: Candaṃ kho tvaṃ dohaḷāyasi Suriyaṃ vā athavāpi Mālutaṃ dullabhe hi Vidhūrassa dassane ko Vidhūraṃ idha-m-ānayissatīti.
ja546:4.1: Kin nu tāta tuvaṃ pajhāyasi, padumaṃ hatthagataṃ va te mukhaṃ, kiṃ dummanarūpo si issara, mā tvaṃ soci amittatāpanā 'ti.
ja546:5.1: Mātā hi tava Irandati Vidhurassa hadayaṃ vanīyati, dullabhe hi Vidhurassa dassane ko Vidhūraṃ idha-m-ānayissati.
ja546:6.1: Bhattu pariyesanañ cara yo Vidhūraṃ idha-m-ānayissatīti. Pituno ca sā sutvāna vākyaṃ rattiṃ nikkhamma avassutiṃ carīti.
ja546:7.1: Ke gandhabbe ca rakkhase nāge kiṃpurise ca mānuse ke paṇḍite sabbakāmade dīgharattaṃ bhattā bhavissatīti.
ja546:8.1: Assāsa hessāmi te pati, bhattā te [hessāmi] anindilocane, paññā hi mama tathāvidhā, assāsa hessasi bhariyā maman
ja546:9.1: ti. Atha naṃ avacāsi Irandatī pubbapathānugatena cetasā: ehi gacchāma pitu mam' antike, eso ca te etam atthaṃ pavakkhatīti.
ja546:10.1: Alaṃkatā suvasanā mālinī candanussadā yakkhaṃ hatthe gahetvāna pitu santikaṃ upāgamīti.
ja546:11.1: Nāgavara vaco suṇohi me: patirūpaṃ paṭipajja suṃkiyaṃ, patthemi ahaṃ Irandatiṃ, tāya samaṅgikarohi me tuvaṃ.
ja546:12.1: Sataṃ hatthī sataṃ assā sataṃ assatarī rathā sataṃ vaḷabhiyo puṇṇā nānāratanassa kevalā -- te nāga paṭipajjassu, dhītaraṃ dehi Irandatin ti.
ja546:13.1: Yāva āmantaye ñātī mitte ca suhadaṃ janaṃ, anāmanta kataṃ kammaṃ taṃ pacchā-m-anutappatīti.
ja546:14.1: Tato so Varuṇo nāgo pavisitvā nivesanaṃ bhariyaṃ āmantayitvāna idaṃ vacanaṃ abravi:
ja546:15.1: Ayaṃ so Puṇṇako yakkho yācatī maṃ Irandatiṃ, bahunā vittalābhena tassa dema piyaṃ maman ti.
ja546:16.1: Na dhanena na vittena labbhā amhaṃ Irandatī, sace hi kho hadayaṃ paṇḍitassa dhammena laddhā idha-m-āhareyya etena vittena kumāri labbhā, n' aññaṃ dhanaṃ uttari patthayāmā
ja546:17.1: 'ti. Tato so Varuṇo nāgo nikkhamitvā nivesanā Puṇṇak' āmantayitvāna idaṃ vacanaṃ abravi:
ja546:18.1: Na dhanena na vittena labbhā amhaṃ Irandatī, sace tuvaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍitassa dhammena laddhā idha-m-āharesi etena vittena kumāri labbhā, n' aññaṃ dhanaṃ uttari patthayāmā 'ti.
ja546:19.1: Yaṃ paṇḍito ty-eke vadanti loke tam eva bālo ti punāhu aññe, akkhāhi me, vippavadanti ettha, kaṃ paṇḍitaṃ nāga tuvaṃ vadesīti.
ja546:20.1: Koravyarājassa Dhanañjayassa yadi te suto Vidhuro nāma kattā ānehi taṃ paṇḍitaṃ, dhammaladdhā Irandatī paddhacarā te hotū
ja546:21.1: 'ti. Idañ ca sutvā Varuṇassa vākyaṃ uṭṭhāya yakkho paramappatīto tatth' eva santo purisaṃ asaṃsi: ānehi ājaññam idh' eva yuttan ti.
ja546:22.1: Jātarūpamayā kaṇṇā, kācambhamayā khurā, jambonadassa pākassa suvaṇṇassa uracchado ti.
ja546:23.1: Devavāhavahaṃ yānaṃ assaṃ āruyha Puṇṇako alaṃkato kappitakesamassu pakkāmi vehāsayam antalikkhe.
ja546:24.1: Sa Puṇṇako kāmavegena giddho Irandatiṃ nāgakaññaṃ jigiṃsaṃ gantvāna taṃ bhūtapatiṃ yasassiṃ icc-abravī Vessavaṇaṃ Kuveraṃ.
ja546:25.1: Bhogavatī nāma mandire vāsā Hiraññavatīti vuccati, nagare nimmite kañcanamaye maṇḍalassa uragassa niṭṭhitaṃ.
ja546:26.1: Aṭṭālakā oṭṭhagīviyo lohitaṃkamasāragallino, pāsād' ettha silāmayā (add: suvaṇṇā?) sovaṇṇaratanena chāditā.
ja546:27.1: Ambā tilakā ca jambuyo sattapaṇṇā mucalindaketakā piyakā uddālakā sahā uparibhaddakā sinduvāritā
ja546:28.1: Campeyyakā nāgamālikā bhaginīmālā atha-m-ettha koliyā ete dumā parināmitā (add: va?) sobhayanti uragassa mandiraṃ.
ja546:29.1: Khajjur' ettha silāmayā sovaṇṇadhuvapupphitā bahu yattha vasat' opapātiko nāgarājā Varuṇo mahiddhiko.
ja546:30.1: Tassa komārikā bhariyā Vimalā kañcanavelliviggahā kālā taruṇā va uggatā pucimandathanī cārudassanā
ja546:31.1: Lākhārasarattasucchavi kaṇikāro va nivātapupphito tidivokacarā va accharā vijjut' abbhaghanā va nissaṭā.
ja546:32.1: Sā dohaḷinī suvimhitā Vidhurassa hadayaṃ vanīyati, taṃ tesaṃ dadāmi issara tena te denti Irandatiṃ maman ti.
ja546:33.1: Sa Puṇṇako bhūtapatiṃ yasassiṃ āmantaya Vessavaṇaṃ Kuveraṃ tatth' eva santaṃ purisaṃ asaṃsi: ānehi ājaññaṃ idh' eva yuttaṃ.
ja546:34.1: Jātarūpamayā kaṇṇā, kācambhamayā khurā, jambonadassa pākassa suvaṇṇassa uracchado.
ja546:35.1: Devavāhavahaṃ yānaṃ assam āruyha Puṇṇako alaṃkato kappitakesamassu pakkāmi vehāsayaṃ antalikhe ti.
ja546:36.1: So agamā Rājagahaṃ surammaṃ Aṅgassa rañño nagaraṃ durāyutaṃ pahūtabhakkhaṃ bahuannapānaṃ Masakkasāraṃ viya Vāsavassa
ja546:37.1: Mayūrakoñcagaṇasampaghuṭṭhaṃ dijābhighuṭṭhaṃ dijasaṃghasevitaṃ nānāsakuntābhirudaṃ subhaṃgaṇaṃ pupphābhikiṇṇaṃ Himavaṃ va pabbataṃ.
ja546:38.1: Sa Puṇṇako Vepullam ābhirucchi siluccayaṃ kimpurisānuciṇṇaṃ anvesamāno [maṇi] ratanaṃ uḷāraṃ, tam addasā pabbatakūṭamajjhe ti.
ja546:39.1: Disvā maṇiṃ pabhassaraṃ jātimantaṃ dhanāharaṃ [maniratanaṃ uḷāraṃ] daddallamānaṃ yasasā yasassinaṃ obhāsatī vijju-r-iv' antalikkhe.
ja546:40.1: Tam aggahī veḷuriyaṃ mahagghaṃ manoharaṃ nāma mahānubhāvaṃ, ājaññam āruyha anomavaṇṇo pakkāmi vehāsayam antalikkhe ti.
ja546:41.1: So agamā nagaraṃ Indapattaṃ oruyha cāgañchi sabhaṃ Kurūnaṃ, samāgame ekasataṃ samagge avhettha yakkho avikampamāno:
ja546:42.1: Ko n' īdha raññaṃ varam ābhijeti, kam ābhijeyyāma varaṃdhanena kam anuttaraṃ ratanavaraṃ jināma ko vāpi no jeti varaṃ dhanānaṃ.
ja546:43.1: Kuhin nu raṭṭhe tava jātabhūmi, na Koravyass' eva vaco tav' etaṃ, abhibhosi no vaṇṇanibhāya sabbe, akkhāhi me nāmañ ca bandhave cā 'ti.
ja546:44.1: Kaccāyano māṇavako 'smi rāja, Anūnanāmo iti m' avhayanti, Aṅgesu me ñātayo bandhavā ca, akkhena dev' asmi idhānupatto ti.
ja546:45.1: Kiṃ māṇavassa ratanāni atthi ye taṃ jinanto hare akkhadhutto, bahūni rañño ratanāni atthi, te tvaṃ daliddo katham avhayesīti.
ja546:46.1: Manoharo nāma maṇī mamāyaṃ, dhanāharaṃ maṇiratanaṃ uḷāraṃ imañ ca ājaññaṃ amittatāpanaṃ etaṃ me jetvā hare akkhadhutto ti g. ā.
ja546:47.1: Eko maṇī māṇava kiṃ karissati, ājāniy' eko pana kiṃ karissati, bahūni rañño maṇiratanāni ājāniyā vātajavā anappakā ti.
ja546:49.0: ca me maṇiratanaṃ passa tvaṃ dipaduttama: itthīnaṃ viggahā c' ettha purisānañ ca viggahā,
ja546:50.1: Migānaṃ viggahā c' ettha sakuṇānañ ca viggahā, nāgarāje supaṇṇe ca maṇimhi passa nimmitan ti.
ja546:51.1: Hatthānīkaṃ rathānīkaṃ asse pattī dhajāni ca caturaṅginiṃ imaṃ senaṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:52.1: Hatthāruhe anīkaṭṭhe rathike pattikārike balaggāni viyūḷhāni maṇimhi passa nimmitan ti.
ja546:53.1: Puraṃ uddāpasampannaṃ bahupākāratoraṇaṃ siṃghāṭakesu bhūmiyo maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:54.1: Esikā parikhāyo ca palikhaṃ aggalāni ca aṭṭālake ca dvāre ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:55.1: Passa: toraṇamaggesu nānādijagaṇā bahū haṃsā koñcā mayūrā ca cakkavākā ca kukkuhā (V 406|2).
ja546:56.1: Kuṇālakā bahucitrā sikhaṇḍī jīvajīvakā, nānādijaganākiṇṇaṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:57.1: Passa nagaraṃ supākāraṃ abbhutaṃ lomahaṃsanaṃ samussitadhajaṃ rammaṃ suvaṇṇavālukasanthataṃ.
ja546:58.1: Passa tvaṃ paṇṇasālāyo vibhattā bhāgaso mitā nivesane nivese ca sandhibbūhe patatthiyo
ja546:59.1: Pānāgāre ca soṇḍe ca sūṇā odaniyāgharā vesī ca gaṇikāyo ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:60.1: Mālākāre ca rajake ganthike atha dussike suvaṇṇakāre maṇikāre maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:61.1: Ālāriye ca sūde ca naṭanaṭṭakagāyane pāṇissare kumbhathūnike maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:62.1: Passa: bherī mutiṅgā ca saṃkhāpaṇavadeṇḍimā, sabbañ ca tālāvacaraṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:63.1: Sammatālañ ca vīṇañ ca naccagītaṃ suvāditaṃ turiyatāḷitasaṃghuṭṭhaṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:64.1: Laṃghikā muṭṭhikā c' ettha māyākārā ca sobhiyā, vetālike ca jalle ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:65.1: Samajjā c' ettha vattanti ākiṇṇā naranāribhi, mañcātimañce bhūmiyo maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:66.1: Passa malle samajjasmiṃ poṭhente digunaṃ bhujaṃ nihate nihatamāne ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:67.1: Passa: pabbatapādesu nānāmigagaṇā bahū sīhavyagghavarāhā ca acchakokataracchayo (V 406|5)
ja546:68.1: Palasatā ca gavajā ca mahisā rohitā rurū eṇeyyā ca varāhā ca gaṇino niṃkasūkarā
ja546:69.1: Kadalīmigā bahucitrā biḷārā sasakaṇṇakā, nānāmigagaṇākiṇṇaṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:70.1: Najjāyo supatiṭṭhāyo soṇṇavālukasanthatā acchā savanti ambūni macchagumbanisevitā.
ja546:71.1: Kumbhīlā makarā c' ettha suṃsumārā ca kacchapā pāṭhīnā pāvusā macchā vālajā muñjarohitā.
ja546:72.1: Nānādumagaṇākiṇṇā nānādijagaṇāyutā veḷuriyakaro dāyo, maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:73.1: Pass' ettha pokkharaṇiyo suvibhattā catuddisā nānādijagaṇākiṇṇā puthulomanisevitā.
ja546:74.1: Samantūdakasampannaṃ mahiṃ sāgarakuṇḍalaṃ upetaṃ vanarājehi maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:75.1: Purato Videhe passa Goyāniye ca pacchato Kuruyo Jambudīpañ ca maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:76.1: Passa Candañ ca Suriyañ ca obhāsante catuddisā Sineruṃ anupariyante, maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:77.1: Sineruṃ Himavantañ ca sāgarañ ca mahiddhikaṃ cattāro ca mahārāje maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:78.1: Ārāme vanagumbe ca pāṭiye ca siluccaye ramme kimpurisākiṇṇe maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:79.1: Phārusakaṃ cittalataṃ missakaṃ Nandanaṃ vanaṃ Vejayantañ ca pāsādaṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:80.1: Sudhammaṃ Tāvatiṃsañ ca Pāricchattañ ca pupphitaṃ Erāvaṇaṃ nāgarājaṃ maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:81.1: Pass' ettha devakaññāyo nabhā vijju-r-iv' uggatā Nandane vicarantiyo, maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:82.1: Pass' ettha devakaññāyo devaputtapalobhinī devaputte caramāne, maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:83.1: Parosahassapāsāde veluriyaphalasanthate pajjalantena vaṇṇena maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:84.1: Tāvatiṃse ca Yāme ca Tusite cāpi nimmite Paranimmitābhiratino maṇimhi passa nimmitaṃ.
ja546:85.1: Pass' ettha pokkharaṇiyo vippasannodikā sucī mandālakehi sañchannā padumuppalakehi ca.
ja546:86.1: Das' ettha rājiyo setā dasa nīlā manoramā cha piṅgalā pannarasā haliddā ca catuddasā.
ja546:87.1: Vīsatī tattha sovaṇṇā vīsatī rajatāmayā indagopakavaṇṇābhā tāva dissanti tiṃsati.
ja546:88.1: Das' ettha kāḷiyo chā ca mañjeṭṭhā paṇṇavīsati missā bandhukapupphehi nīluppalavicittitā.
ja546:89.1: Evaṃ sabbaṅgasampannaṃ accimantaṃ pabhassaraṃ odhisuṃkaṃ mahārāja passa tvaṃ dipaduttama.
ja546:91.0: Upāgataṃ rāja upehi lakkhaṃ, n' etādisaṃ maṇiratanaṃ tav' atthi, dhammena jiyyāma asāhasena, jito ca no khippam avākarohīti.
ja546:92.1: Pañcāla paccuggata Sūrasena Macchā ca Maddā saha Kekakehi passantu no te asaṭhena yuddhaṃ na no sabhāyaṃ na karoti kiñcīti.
ja546:93.1: Te pāvisuṃ akkhamadena mattā rājā Kurūnaṃ Puṇṇako [ca] pi yakkho, rājā kaliṃ vicinaṃ aggahesi, kaṭam aggahī Puṇṇako pi yakkho.
ja546:94.1: Te tattha jūte ubhayo samāgate raññaṃ sakāse sakhinañ ca majjhe, ajesi yakkho naraviriyaseṭṭhaṃ, tattha-ppanādo tumulo babhūvā 'ti*.
ja546:95.1: Jayo mahārāja parājayo ca āyūhataṃ aññatarassa hoti, janinda jito si varaṃdhanena jito ca me khippam avākarohīti.
ja546:96.1: Hatthī gavassā maṇikuṇḍalā ca yaṃ cāpi mayhaṃ ratanaṃ pathavyā gaṇhāhi Kaccāna varaṃ dhanānaṃ, ādāya yen' icchasi tena gacchā 'ti.
ja546:97.1: Hatthī gavassā maṇikuṇḍalā ca yañ cāpi tuyhaṃ ratanaṃ pathavyā tesaṃ varo Vidhuro nāma kattā, so me jito, tam me avākarohīti.
ja546:98.1: Attā ca me so saraṇaṃ gatī ca dīpo ca leṇo ca parāyano ca, asantuleyyo mama so dhanena, pāṇena me sadiso esa kattā ti.
ja546:99.1: Ciraṃ vivādo mama tuyham assa, kāmañ ca pucchāma tam eva gantvā, eso va no vivaratu etam atthaṃ, yaṃ vakkhatī hotu kathā ubhinnan ti.
ja546:100.1: Addhā hi saccaṃ bhaṇasi na ca māṇava sāhasaṃ, tam eva gantvā pucchāma, tena tussām' ubho janā ti.
ja546:101.1: Saccaṃ nu devā vidahū Kurūnaṃ dhamme ṭhitaṃ Vidhuraṃ nām' amaccaṃ, dāso si rañño uda vāsi ñāti Vidhuro ti saṃkhā katamāsi loke ti.
ja546:102.1: Āmāyadāsāpi bhavanti h' eke, dhanena kītāpi bhavanti dāsā, sayam pi h' eke upayanti dāsā, bhayā paṇunnāpi bhavanti dāsā.
ja546:103.1: Ete narānaṃ caturo va dāsā, addhā hi yonito aham pi jāto, bhavo ca rañño abhavo ca rañño, dās' āhaṃ devassa param pi gantvā dhammena maṃ māṇava tuyhaṃ dajjā ti.
ja546:104.1: Ayaṃ dutīyo vijayo mam' ajja puṭṭho hi kattā vivar' ettha pañhaṃ, adhammarūpo vata rājaseṭṭho, subhāsitaṃ n' anujānāsi mayhan ti.
ja546:105.1: Evañ ce no so vivar' ettha pañhaṃ ‘dāso 'ham asmi, na ca kho 'smi ñāti' gaṇhāhi Kaccāna varaṃ dhanānaṃ, ādāya yen' icchasi tena gacchā
ja546:107.0: 'ti. Vidhura vasamānassa gahaṭṭhassa sakaṃ gharaṃ khemā vatti kathaṃ assa, kathan nu assa saṃgaho.
ja546:108.1: Avyāpajjhaṃ kathaṃ assa, saccavādī ca māṇavo asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ kathaṃ pecca na socatīti.
ja546:109.1: [Taṃ] tattha gatimā dhitimā mutimā atthadassimā saṃkhātā sabbadhammānaṃ Vidhuro etad abravi:
ja546:110.1: Na sādhāraṇadār' assa, na bhuñje sādum ekato, na seve lokāyatikaṃ, n' etaṃ paññāya vaddhanaṃ.
ja546:111.1: Sīlavā vattasampanno appamatto vicakkhaṇo nivātavutti atthaddho surato sakhilo mudu
ja546:112.1: Saṃgahe tāva mittānaṃ saṃvibhāgī vidhānavā tappeyya annapānena sadā samaṇabrāhmaṇe.
ja546:113.1: Dhammakāmo sutādhāro bhaveyya paripucchako sakkacca payirupāseyya sīlavante hahussute.
ja546:114.1: Gharam āvasamānassa gahaṭṭhassa sakaṃ gharaṃ khemā vatti siyā evaṃ, evan nu assa saṃgaho.
ja546:115.1: Avyāpajjho siyā evaṃ saccavādī ca māṇavo asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ evaṃ pecca na socatīti.
ja546:117.0: Ehi dāni gamissāmi, dinno no issarena me, tam ev' atthaṃ paṭipajja esa dhammo sanantano ti.
ja546:118.1: Jānāmi māṇava: tayāham asmi, dinno 'ham asmi tava issarena, tīhañ ca taṃ vāsayemu agāre yen' addhunā anusāsemu putte
ja546:119.1: ti. Tam me tathā hotu vasemu tīhaṃ, kurutaṃ bhav' ajja gharesu kiccaṃ, anusāsataṃ puttadāre bhav' ajja yathā tayī pacchā sukhī bhaveyyā 'ti.
ja546:120.1: Sādhū 'ti vatvāna pahūtakāmo pakkhāmi yakkho Vidhurena saddhiṃ, taṃ kuñjarājaññahayānuciṇṇaṃ pāvekkhi antopuram ariyaseṭṭho ti.
ja546:121.1: Koñcaṃ Mayūrañ ca Piyañ ca Ketaṃ upāgami tattha surammarūpaṃ pahūtabhakkhaṃ bahuannapānaṃ Masakkasāraṃ viya Vāsavassā
ja546:122.1: 'ti. Tattha naccanti gāyanti avhayanti varāvaraṃ accharā viya devesu nāriyo samalaṃkatā ti.
ja546:123.1: Samaṅgikatvā pamadāhi yakkhaṃ annena pānena ca Dhammapālo atthattham evānuvicintayanto pāvekkhi bhariyāya tadā sakāse
ja546:124.1: ti. Taṃ candanagandharasānulittaṃ suvaṇṇajambonadanikkhasādisaṃ bhariyaṃ vacā: ehi sunohi bhoti, puttāni āmantaya tambanette.
ja546:125.1: Sutvāna vākyaṃ patino Anujjā suṇisaṃ vaca tambanakhīsunettaṃ: āmantaya vammadharāni Cete puttāni indīvarapupphasāme.
ja546:126.1: Te āgate muddhani Dhammapālo cumbitvā putte avikampamāno āmantayitvā ca avoca vākyaṃ: dinn' āhaṃ raññā idha māṇavassa.
ja546:127.1: Tass' ajj' ahaṃ attasukhī vidheyyo, ādāya yen' icchati tena gacchati, ahañ ca vo sasituṃ āgato 'smi: kathaṃ ahaṃ aparittāya gacche.
ja546:128.1: Sace vo rājā Kurukhettavāsī Janasandho puccheyya pahūtakāmo kim ābhijānātha pure purāṇaṃ kiṃ vo pitā anusāse puratthā
ja546:129.1: Samāsanā hotha mayā va sabbe ko n' īdha rañño abbhatiko manusso tam añjaliṃ kariya vadetha evaṃ: mā h' eva deva, na hi esa dhammo, viyaggharājassa nihīnajacco samāsano deva kathaṃ bhaveyyā
ja546:131.0: 'ti. So ca mitte amitte ca ñātayo suhadajjane alīnamanasaṃkappo Vidhuro etad abravi:
ja546:132.1: Eth' ayyo rājavasatiṃ nisīditvā suṇotha me yathā rājakulaṃ patto yasaṃ poso nigacchatītī.
ja546:133.1: Na hi rājakulaṃ patto aññāto labhate yasaṃ nāsūro na pi dummedho na-ppamatto kudācanaṃ.
ja546:134.1: Yadāssa sīlaṃ paññañ ca soceyyañ cādhigacchati atha vissasate tyamhi guyhañ c' assa na rakkhati.
ja546:135.1: Tulā yathā paggahitā samadaṇḍā sudhāritā ajjhiṭṭho na vikampeyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:136.1: Tulā yathā paggahitā samadaṇḍā sudhāritā sabbāni abhisambhonto sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:137.1: Divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ rājakiccesu paṇḍito ajjhiṭṭho na vikampeyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:138.1: Divā vā yadi vā rattiṃ rājakiccesu paṇḍito sabbāni abhisambhonto sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:139.1: Yo c' assa sukato maggo rañño suppaṭiyādito na tena vutto gaccheyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:140.1: Na rañño samakaṃ bhuñje kāmabhoge kudācanaṃ sabbattha pacchato gacche sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:141.1: Na rañño sadisaṃ vatthaṃ na mālā na vilepanaṃ ākappaṃ sarakuttiṃ vā na rañño sadisam ācare aññaṃ kareyya ākappaṃ sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:142.1: Kīḷe rājā amaccehi bhariyāhi parivārito, nāmacco rājabhariyāsu bhāvaṃ kubbetha paṇḍito.
ja546:143.1: Anuddhato acapalo nipako saṃvutindriyo manopaṇidhisampanno sa rājavasatiṃ vase ti.
ja546:144.1: Nāssa bhariyāhi kīḷeyya na manteyya rahogato nāssa kosādhanaṃ gaṇhe sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:145.1: Na niddannaṃ bahuṃ maññe na madāya suraṃ pive nāssa dāye migaṃ haññe sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:146.1: Nāssa pīṭhaṃ na pallaṃkaṃ na kocchaṃ na nāgaṃ rathaṃ sammato 'mhīti ārūhe sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:147.1: Nātidūre bhave rañño nāccāsanne vicakkhaṇo, sammukhe c' assa tiṭṭheyya sandissanto sabhattuno.
ja546:148.1: Na ve rājā saṃkhā hoti na rājā hoti methuno, khippaṃ kujjhanti rājāno sūken' akkhiṃ va ghaṭṭitaṃ.
ja546:149.1: Na pūjito maññamāno medhāvī paṇḍito naro pharusaṃ patimanteyya rājānaṃ parisaṃkitaṃ.
ja546:150.1: Laddhavāro labhe vāraṃ n' eva rājūsu vissase aggīva yato tiṭṭheyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:151.1: Puttaṃ vā bhātaraṃ saṃ vā sampaggaṇhāti khattiyo gāmehi nigamehi vā raṭṭhe janapadehi vā tuṇhībhūto upekkheyya, na bhaṇe chekapāpakaṃ.
ja546:152.1: Hatthārūhe anīkaṭṭhe rathike pattikārike tesaṃ kammāvadānena rājā vaḍḍheti vetanaṃ na tesaṃ antarā gacche sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:153.1: Cāpo v' ūnudaro dhīro vaṃso vāpi pakampaye paṭilomaṃ na vatteyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:154.1: Cāpo v' ūnudaro assa maccho v' assa ajivhavā appāsī nipako sūro sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:155.1: Na bāḷhaṃ itthiṃ gaccheyya sampassaṃ tejasaṃkhayaṃ, kāsaṃ sāsaṃ daraṃ balyaṃ khīṇamedho nigacchati.
ja546:156.1: Nātivelaṃ pabhāseyya, na tuṇhī sabbadā siyā, avikiṇṇaṃ mitaṃ vācaṃ patte kāle udīraye.
ja546:157.1: Akkodhano asaṃghaṭṭo sacco saṇho apesuṇo samphaṃ giraṃ na bhāseyya sa rājavasatim vase.
ja546:159.1: Vinīto sippavā danto katatto niyato mudu appamatto suci dakkho sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:160.1: Nivātavutti vuḍḍhesu sappatisso sagāravo surato sukhasaṃvāso sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:161.1: Ārakā parivajjeyya sahituṃ pahitaṃ janaṃ, bhattārañ ñev' udikkheyya anaññassa ca rājino.
ja546:162.1: Samaṇe brāhmaṇe cāpi sīlavante bahussute sakkaccaṃ payirupāseyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:163.1: Samaṇe brāhmaṇe cāpi sīlavante bahussute sakkaccaṃ anuvāseyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:164.1: Samaṇe brāhmaṇe cāpi sīlavante bahussute tappeyya annapānena sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:165.1: Samaṇe brāhmaṇe cāpi sīlavante bahussute āsajja paññe sevetha ākaṃkha vuddhim attano.
ja546:166.1: Dinnapubbaṃ na hāpeyya dānaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe, na ca kiñci nivāreyya dānakāle vanibbake.
ja546:167.1: Puññavā buddhisampanno vidhānavidhikovido kālaññū samayaññū ca sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:168.1: Uṭṭhātā kammadheyyesu appamatto vicakkhaṇo susaṃvihitakammanto sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:169.1: Khalaṃ sālaṃ pasuṃ khettaṃ gantā c' assa abhikkhaṇaṃ mitaṃ dhaññaṃ nidhāpeyya mitañ ca pācayā ghare.
ja546:170.1: Puttaṃ vā bhātaraṃ saṃ vā sīlesu asamāhitaṃ anaṅgavā hi te bālā yathā petā tath' eva te coḷañ ca nesaṃ piṇḍañ ca āsīnānaṃ va dāpaye.
ja546:171.1: Dāse kammakare pesse sīlesu susamāhite dakkhe uṭṭhānasampanne ādhipaccasmi ṭhāpaye.
ja546:172.1: Sīlavā ca alolo ca anuratto ca rājino avīraho hito tassa sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:173.1: Chandaññū rājino assa cittaṭṭho c' assa rājino asaṃkusakavatti 'ssa sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:174.1: Ucchādaye ca nahāpaye dhove pāde adhosiraṃ āhato pi na kuppeyya sa rājavasatiṃ vase.
ja546:175.1: Kumbhaṃ pañjaliṃ kariyā vāyasaṃ vā padakkhiṇaṃ kim eva sabbakāmānaṃ dātāraṃ dhīram uttamaṃ
ja546:176.1: Yo deti sayanaṃ vatthaṃ yānaṃ āvasathaṃ gharaṃ pajjunno-r-iva bhūtāni bhogehi-m-abhivassati.
ja546:177.1: Es' ayyo rājavasati vattamāno yathā naro ārādhayati rājānaṃ pūjaṃ labhati bhattusū
ja546:179.0: 'ti. Evaṃ samanusāsitvā ñātisaṃghaṃ vicakkhaṇo parikiṇṇo suhadehi rājānaṃ upasaṃkami.
ja546:180.1: Vanditvā sirasā pāde katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ Vidhuro avaca rājānaṃ paggahetvāna añjaliṃ:
ja546:181.1: Ayaṃ maṃ māṇavo neti kattukāmo yathāmatiṃ, ñātīn' atthaṃ pavakkhāmi, taṃ suṇohi arindama.
ja546:182.1: Putte ca me udikkhesi yañ ca m' aññaṃ ghare dhanaṃ yathā pecca na hāyetha ñātisaṃgho mayī gate.
ja546:183.1: Yath' eva khalatī bhumyā bhumyā va patitiṭṭhati ev' etaṃ khalitaṃ mayhaṃ etaṃ passāmi accayan ti.
ja546:184.1: Sakkā na gantuṃ iti mayhaṃ hoti, jhatvā vadhitvā idha Kātiyānaṃ idh' eva hohi iti mayha ruccati, mā tvaṃ agā uttamabhūripaññā 'ti.
ja546:185.1: Mā h' ev' adhammesu manaṃ paṇīdahi, atthe ca dhamme ca yutto bhavassu, dhi-r-atthu kammaṃ akusalaṃ anariyaṃ yaṃ katvā pacchā nirayaṃ vajeyya.
ja546:186.1: N' ev' esa dhammo, na pun' etaṃ kiccaṃ, ayiro hi dāsassa janinda issaro ghātetuṃ jhāpetuṃ atho pi hantuṃ, na ca mayha kodh' atthi vajāmi cāhan ti.
ja546:187.1: Jeṭṭhaputtaṃ upaguyha vineyya hadaye daraṃ assapuṇṇehi nettehi pāvisi so mahāgharan ti.
ja546:188.1: Sālā va sampamathitā mālutena pamadditā senti puttā ca dārā ca Vidhurassa nivesane.
ja546:189.1: Itthīsahassaṃ bhariyānaṃ dāsīsattasatāni ca bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ Vidhurassa nivesane.
ja546:190.1: Orodhā ca kumārā ca vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ Vidhurassa nivesane.
ja546:191.1: Hatthāruhā anīkaṭṭhā rathikā pattikārikā bāhā etc. Samāgatā
ja546:192.1: jānapadā negamā ca samāgatā bāhā etc. Itthīsahassaṃ
ja546:193.1: bhariyānaṃ dāsā sattasatāni ca bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ, kasmā no vijahessasi.
ja546:194.1: Orodhā ca kumārā ca vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ, kasmā no vijahessasi.
ja546:195.1: Hatthārūhā anīkaṭṭhā rathikā pattikārikā bāhā etc. Samāgatā jānapadā
ja546:197.1: Katvā gharesu kiccāni anusāsitvā sakaṃ janaṃ mittāmacce ca suhajje puttadāre ca bandhave
ja546:198.1: Kammantaṃ saṃvidhetvāna ācikkhitvā ghare dhanaṃ nidhiñ ca iṇadānañ ca Puṇṇakaṃ etad abravi:
ja546:199.1: Avasī tuvaṃ mayha tīhaṃ agāre, katāni kiccāni gharesu mayhaṃ, anusāsitā puttadārā mayā ca, karoma Kaccāna yathāmatiṃ te ti.
ja546:200.1: Sace hi katte anusāsitā te puttā ca dārā ca anujīvino ca hand' esa hīdāni taramānarūpo dīgho hi addhāpi ayaṃ puratthā.
ja546:201.1: Asambhīto va gaṇhāhi ajānīyassa vāladhiṃ, idaṃ pacchimakaṃ tuyhaṃ jīvalokassa dassanan ti.
ja546:202.1: So 'haṃ kissānubhāyissaṃ yassa me n' atthi dukkataṃ kāyena vācā manasā yena gaccheyya duggatin ti.
ja546:203.1: So assarājā Vidhuraṃ vahanto pakkāmi vehāsayaṃ antalikkhe, sākhāsu selesu asajjamāno Kālāgiriṃ khippam upāgamāsīti.
ja546:204.1: Itthīsahassaṃ bhariyānaṃ dāsā sattasatāni ca bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ, [yakkho brāhmaṇavaṇṇena] Vidhuraṃ ādāya gacchati.
ja546:207.1: Itthīsahassaṃ bhariyānaṃ dāsī sattasatāni ca bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ: paṇḍito so kuhiṃ gato.
ja546:210.1: Sace so sattarattena paṇḍito nāgamissati sabbe aggiṃ pavekkhāma, n' atth' attho jīvitena no ti.
ja546:211.1: Paṇḍito ca viyatto ca vibhāvī ca vicakkhaṇo khippaṃ mocessat' attānaṃ, mā bhātha āgamissatīti.
ja546:213.0: So tattha gantvāna vicintayanto uccāvacā cetanakā bhavanti imassa jīvena na h' atthi kiñci hantvān' imaṃ hadayaṃ ādiyissan ti.
ja546:214.1: So tattha gantvā pabbatantarasmiṃ anto pavisitvā paduṭṭhacitto asaṃvutasmiṃ jagatippadese adhosiraṃ dhārayi Kātiyāno ti.
ja546:215.1: So lambamāno narake papāte mahabbhaye lomahaṃse vidugge asantasaṃ Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭho icc-abravī Puṇṇakaṃ nāma yakkhaṃ:
ja546:216.1: Ariyāvakāso si anariyarūpo asaññato saññatasannikāso, accāhitaṃ kammaṃ karosi ludraṃ, bhāve ca te kusalaṃ n' atthi kiñci.
ja546:217.1: Yaṃ maṃ papātasmiṃ pamuttam icchasi ko nu tav' attho maraṇena mayhaṃ, amānusass' eva te ajja vaṇṇo, ācikkha me tvaṃ katamāsi devatā.
ja546:218.1: Yadi te suto Puṇṇako nāma yakkho, rañño Kuverassa hi so sajīvo, bhūmindharo Varuṇo nāma nāgo brahā sucī vaṇṇabalūpapanno.
ja546:219.1: Tassānujaṃ dhītaraṃ kāmayāmi, Irandatī nāma sā nāgakaññā, tassā sumajjhāya piyāya hetu patārayiṃ tuyha vadhāya dhīrā 'ti.
ja546:220.1: Mā h' eva tvaṃ yakkha ahosi mūḷho, naṭṭhā bahū duggahītena loko, kiṃ te sumajjhāya piyāya kiccaṃ maraṇena me, iṃgha suṇoma sabban ti.
ja546:221.1: Mahānubhāvassa mahoragassa dhītukkamo ñātigato 'ham asmi, taṃ yācamānaṃ sasuro avoca yathā maṃ aññiṃsu sukāmanītaṃ,
ja546:222.1: Dajjemu kho te sutanuṃ sunettaṃ sucimhitaṃ candanalittagattiṃ sace tuvaṃ hadayaṃ paṇḍitassa dhammena laddhā idha-m-āharesi, etena vittena kumāri labbhā, nāññaṃ dhanaṃ uttariṃ patthayāma.
ja546:223.1: Evaṃ na mūḷho 'smi, suṇohi katte, na cāpi me duggahit' atthi kiñci, hadayena te dhammaladdhena nāgā Irandatiṃ nāgakaññaṃ dadanti.
ja546:224.1: Tasmā ahaṃ tuyhaṃ vadhāya yutto, evaṃ mam' attho maraṇena tuyhaṃ, idh' eva taṃ narake pātayitvā hantvāna taṃ hadayaṃ ādiyissan ti.
ja546:225.1: Khippaṃ mamaṃ uddhara Kātiyāna hadayena me yadi te atthi kiccaṃ, ye kec' ime sādhunarassa dhammā sabbe va te pātukaromi ajjā 'ti.
ja546:226.1: Sa Puṇṇako Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ nagamuddhanī khippaṃ patiṭṭhapetvā assattham āsīnaṃ samekkhiyānaṃ paripucchi kattāram anomapaññaṃ:
ja546:227.1: Samuddhato me si tuvaṃ papātā, hadayena te ajja mam' atthi kiccaṃ, ye kec' ime sādhunarassa dhammā sabbe va me pātukarohi ajjā 'ti.
ja546:228.1: Samuddhato ty-asmi{} ahaṃ papātā, hadayena me yadi te atthi kiccaṃ ye kec' ime sādhunarassa dhammā sabbe va te pātukaromi ajjā 'ti
ja546:229.1: Yātānuyāyī ca bhavāhi māṇava, addañ ca pāṇiṃ parivajjayassu, mā c' assu mittesu kadāci dūbhī, mā ca vasaṃ asatīnaṃ nigacche.
ja546:230.1: Kathan nu yātaṃ anuyāyi hoti addañ ca pāṇiṃ dahate kathaṃ so asatī ca kā ko pana mittadūbho, akkhāhi me pucchito etam atthan ti.
ja546:231.1: Asanthutaṃ no pi ca diṭṭhapubbaṃ yo āsanenāpi nimantayeyya tass' eva atthaṃ puriso kareyya, yātānuyāyīti tam āhu paṇḍitā.
ja546:232.1: Yass' ekarattim pi ghare vaseyya yatth' annapānaṃ puriso labhetha na tassa pāpaṃ manasābhicetaye, adubbhapāṇiṃ dahate mittadūbho.
ja546:233.1: Yassa rukkhassa chāyāya nisīdeyya sayeyya vā (= V.240|21) na tassa sākhaṃ bhañjeyya, mittadūbho hi pāpako.
ja546:234.1: Puṇṇam pi c' etaṃ paṭhaviṃ dhanena dajj' itthiyā puriso sammatāya laddhā khaṇaṃ atimaññeyya tam pi, tāsaṃ vasaṃ asatīnaṃ na gacche.
ja546:235.1: Evaṃ kho yātaṃ anuyāyi hoti addañ ca pāṇiṃ dahate pun' evaṃ asatī ca sā so pana mittadūbho, so dhammiyo hoti, jahassu adhamman
ja546:237.0: ti. Avasiṃ ahaṃ tuyha tīhaṃ agāre, annena pānena upaṭṭhito 'smi, mitto mamāsī, visajām' ahan taṃ, kāmaṃ gharaṃ uttamapañña gacche.
ja546:238.1: Api hāyatu nāgakulassa attho, alam pi me nāgakaññāya hotu, so tvaṃ saken' eva subhāsitena mutto si me ajja vadhāya paññā ti.
ja546:239.1: Handa tuvaṃ yakkha mamam pi nehi sasuran nu te, atthaṃ mayī carassu, aham pi nāgādhipatīvimānaṃ dakkhemu nāgassa adiṭṭhapubban ti.
ja546:240.1: Yaṃ ve narassa ahitāya assa na taṃ pañño arahati dassanāya, atha kena vaṇṇena amittagāmaṃ tuvam icchasī uttamapañña gantun ti.
ja546:241.1: Addhā pajānāmi aham pi etaṃ na taṃ pañño arahati dassanāya, pāpañ ca me n' atthi kataṃ kuhiñci tasmā na saṃke maraṇāgamāyā 'ti.
ja546:242.1: Handa ca ṭhānaṃ atulānubhāvaṃ mayā sahā dakkhisi, ehi katte yatth' acchati{} naccagītehi nāgo rājā yathā Vessavaṇo Naḷiññaṃ.
ja546:243.1: Taṃ nāgakaññā caritaṃ gaṇena nikīḷitaṃ niccam aho va rattiṃ pahūtamalyaṃ bahupupphachannaṃ obhāsatī vijju-r-iv' antalikkhe.
ja546:244.1: Annena pānena upetarūpaṃ naccehi gītehi ca vāditehi paripūra kaññāhi alaṃkatāhi upasobhatī vatthapilandhanenā 'ti.
ja546:245.1: So Puṇṇako Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ nisīdayī pacchato āsanasmiṃ, ādāya kattāram anomapaññaṃ upānayī bhavanaṃ nāgarañño.
ja546:246.1: Patvāna ṭhānaṃ atulānubhāvaṃ aṭṭhā kattā pacchato Puṇṇakassa, sāmaggipekkhī pana nāgarājā pubbe va jāmātaram ajjhabhāsatha.
ja546:247.1: Yan nu tuvaṃ agamā maccalokaṃ anvesamāno hadayaṃ paṇḍitassa, kacci samiddhena idhānupatto ādāya kattāraṃ anomapaññan ti.
ja546:248.1: Ayaṃ hi so āgato yan tvam icchasi, dhammena laddho mama dhammapālo, taṃ passathā sammukhā bhāsamānaṃ, sukho bhave sappurisehi saṃgamo ti.
ja546:250.1: Adiṭṭhapubbaṃ disvāna macco maccubhayaddito vyamhito nābhivādeti, na ida paññavatām iva.
ja546:251.1: Na c' amhi vyamhito nāga na ca maccubhayaddito na vajjho abhivādeyya vajjhaṃ vā nābhivādaye.
ja546:252.1: Kathaṃ no abhivādeyya abhivādāpayetha ve yaṃ naro hantum iccheyya taṃ kammaṃ na upapajjatīti.
ja546:253.1: Evam etaṃ yathā brūsi saccaṃ bhāsasi paṇḍita: na vajjho abhivādeyya vajjhaṃ vā nābhivādaye.
ja546:254.1: Kathan no abhivādeyya abhivādāpayetha ve yaṃ naro hantum iccheyya taṃ kammaṃ na upapajjatīti.
ja546:255.1: Asassataṃ sassatan no tavedaṃ iddhī jutī balaviriyūpapatti, pucchāmi taṃ nāgarāj' etam atthaṃ: kathan nu te laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ.
ja546:256.1: Adhicca laddhaṃ pariṇāmajan te (V 171|9) sayaṃkataṃ udāhu devehi dinnaṃ, akkhāhi me nāgarāj' etam atthaṃ yath' eva te laddham idaṃ vimānan ti.
ja546:257.1: Nādhicca laddhaṃ na pariṇāmajaṃ me (V 171|22) na sayaṃkataṃ na pi devehi dinnaṃ, sakehi kammehi apāpakehi puññehi me laddhaṃ idaṃ vimānan ti.
ja546:258.1: Kin te vataṃ kim pana brahmacariyaṃ kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko iddhī jutī balaviriyūpapatti idañ ca te nāga mahāvimānan ti.
ja546:259.1: Ahañ ca bhariyā ca manussaloke saddhā ubho dānapatī ahumhā, opānabhūtaṃ me gharaṃ tadāsi, santappitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca.
ja546:260.1: Mālañ ca gandhañ ca vilepanañ ca padīpiyaṃ seyyam upassayañ ca acchādanaṃ sayanaṃ annapānaṃ sakkacca dānāni adamha tattha.
ja546:261.1: Taṃ me vataṃ tam pana brahmacariyaṃ, (V 172|7) tassa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko iddhī jutī balaviriyūpapatti idañ ca dhīra mahāvimānan ti.
ja546:262.1: Evañ ce te laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ jānāsi puññānaṃ phalūpapattiṃ, tasmā hi dhammañ cara appamatto yathā vimānaṃ punam āvasesīti.
ja546:263.1: Na idha santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā va yes' annapānāni dademu katte, akkhāhi me pucchito etam atthaṃ yathā vimānaṃ punam āvasemā 'ti.
ja546:264.1: Bhogī hi te santi idh' ūpapannā puttā ca dārā anujīvino ca, tesu tuvaṃ vacasā kammanā ca asampaduṭṭho va bhavāhi niccaṃ.
ja546:265.1: Evaṃ tuvaṃ nāga asampadosaṃ anupālayā vacasā kammanā ca, ṭhatvā idhā yāvatāyuṃ vimāne uddhaṃ ito gacchasi devalokan ti.
ja546:266.1: Addhā hi so socati rājaseṭṭho tayā vinā yassa tuvaṃ sajīvo, dukkhūpanīto pi tayā samecca vindeyya poso sukham āturo pīti.
ja546:267.1: Addhā sataṃ bhāsasi nāga dhammaṃ anuttaraṃ atthapadaṃ suciṇṇaṃ, etādisīyāsu hi āpadāsu paññāyate mādisānaṃ viseso ti.
ja546:268.1: Akkhehi no t' āyaṃ mudhā nu laddho, akkhehi no t' āyaṃ ajesi jūte, dhammena laddho iti t' āyam āha, kathaṃ tuvaṃ hattham imassa-m-āgato ti.
ja546:269.1: Yo m' issaro tattha ahosi rājā tam ayam akkhehi ajesi jūte, so maṃ jito rājā imass' adāsi, dhammena laddho 'smi asāhasenā 'ti.
ja546:270.1: Mahorago attamano udaggo sutvāna dhīrassa subhāsitāni hatthe gahetvā anomapaññaṃ pāvekkhi bhariyāya tadā sakāse.
ja546:271.1: Yena tvaṃ Vimale paṇḍu yena bhattaṃ na ruccatī na ca-m-etādiso vaṇṇo ayam eso tamonudo.
ja546:272.1: Yassa te hadayen' attho āgat' āyaṃ pabhaṃkaro, tassa vākyaṃ nisāmehi, dullabhaṃ dassanaṃ puna.
ja546:273.1: Disvāna taṃ Vimalā bhūripaññaṃ dasaṅguliṃ pañjaliṃ paggahetvā haṭṭhena bhāvena patītarūpā icc-abravī Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ.
ja546:274.1: Adiṭṭhapubbaṃ disvāna macco maccubhayaddito vyamhito nābhivādeti, na idaṃ {paññavatām'} iva.
ja546:275.1: Na c' amhi vyamhito nāgi na ca maccubhayaddito, na vajjho abhivādeyya vajjhaṃ vā nābhivādaye.
ja546:276.1: Kathaṃ no abhivādeyya abhivādāpayetha ve yaṃ naro hantum iccheyya taṃ kammaṃ na upapajjati.
ja546:277.1: Evam etaṃ yathā brūsi saccaṃ bhāsasi paṇḍita: na vajjho abhivādeyya vajjhaṃ vā nābhivādaye.
ja546:278.1: Kathaṃ no abhivādeyya abhivādāpayetha ve yaṃ naro hantum iccheyya taṃ kammaṃ na upapajjati.
ja546:279.1: Asassataṃ sassataṃ nū tava-y-idaṃ iddhī jutī balaviriyūpapatti, pucchāmi taṃ nāgakaññe tam atthaṃ: kathan nu te laddham idaṃ vimānan ti --pe--.
ja546:280.1: Adhicca laddhaṃ pariṇāmajan te (V 171|9 etc.) sayaṃkataṃ udāhu devehi dinnaṃ, akkhāhi me nāgakaññe tam atthaṃ yathā ca te laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ.
ja546:281.1: Nādhicca laddhaṃ na pariṇāmajaṃ me na sayaṃkataṃ nāpi devehi dinnaṃ, sakehi kammehi apāpakehi puññehi me laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ.
ja546:282.1: Kin te vataṃ kim pana brahmacariyaṃ (Sumaṅgalā-V. I p. kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko: iddhī jutī balaviriyūpapatti idañ ca te nāgi mahāvimānaṃ.
ja546:283.1: Ahañ ca kho sāmiko cāpi mayhaṃ saddhā ubho dānapatī ahumhā, opānabhūtam me gharaṃ tadāsi, santappitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca.
ja546:284.1: Mālañ ca gandhañ ca vilepanañ ca padīpiyaṃ seyyam upassayañ ca acchādanaṃ sayanaṃ annapānaṃ sakkacca dānāni adamha tattha.
ja546:285.1: Tam me vataṃ tam pana brahmacariyaṃ tassa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko: iddhī jutī balaviriyūpapatti, idañ ca me dhīra mahāvimānaṃ.
ja546:286.1: Evañ ca te laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ, jānāsi puññāna phalūpapattiṃ, tasmā hi dhammañ cara appamatto yathā vimānaṃ punam āvasesi.
ja546:287.1: Na-y-idha-m-atthī {samaṇabrāhmaṇā} vā yes' annapānāni dademu katte, akkhāhi me pucchito etam atthaṃ yathā vimānaṃ punam āvasema.
ja546:288.1: Bhogī hi ye santi idh' ūpapannā puttā ca dārā anujīvino ca tesaṃ tuvaṃ vacasā kammanā ca asampaduṭṭhā hi bhavāhi niccaṃ.
ja546:289.1: Evaṃ tuvaṃ nāgi asampadosaṃ anupālayā vacasā kammanā ca, ṭhatvā idhā yāvatāyuṃ vimāne uddhaṃ ito gacchasi devalokaṃ.
ja546:290.1: Addhā hi so socati rājaseṭṭho tayā vinā yassa tuvaṃ sajīvo, dukkhūpanīto pi tayā samecca vindeyya poso sukham āturo pi.
ja546:291.1: Addhā sataṃ bhāsasi nāgi dhammaṃ anuttaraṃ atthapadaṃ suciṇṇaṃ, etādisīyāsu hi āpadāsu paññāyatī mādisānaṃ viseso.
ja546:292.1: Akkhehi no t' āyaṃ mudhā nu laddho, akkhehi no t' āyaṃ ajesi jūte dhammena laddho iti t' āyam āha, kathaṃ tuvaṃ hattham imassa-m-āgato.
ja546:293.1: Yo m' issaro tattha ahosi rājā tam āyam akkhehi ajesi jūte, so maṃ jito rājā imass' adāsi, dhammena laddho 'smi asāhasenā 'ti.
ja546:294.1: Yad eva Varuṇo nāgo pañhaṃ pucchittha paṇḍitaṃ tad eva nāgakaññāpi pañhaṃ pucchittha paṇḍitaṃ.
ja546:295.1: Yath' eva Varuṇaṃ nāgaṃ dhīro tosesi pucchito tath' eva nāgakaññaṃ pi dhīro tosesi pucchito.
ja546:296.1: Ubho pi te attamane viditvā mahoragaṃ nāgakaññañ ca dhīro acchambhi abhīto alomahaṭṭho icc-abravī Varuṇaṃ nāgarājaṃ:
ja546:297.1: Mā heṭhayī nāga, ay' āham asmi, yena tava attho idaṃ sarīraṃ hadayena maṃsena karoti kiccaṃ, sayaṃ karissāmi yathāmatin te ti.
ja546:298.1: Paññā bhave hadayaṃ paṇḍitānaṃ, te ty-amha paññāya mayaṃ sutuṭṭhā, Anūnanāmo labhat' ajja dāraṃ, ajj' eva taṃ Kuruyo pāpayātū 'ti.
ja546:299.1: Sa Puṇṇako attamano udaggo Irandatiṃ nāgakaññaṃ labhitvā haṭṭhena bhāvena patītarūpo icc-abravī Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ:
ja546:300.1: Bhariyāya maṃ tvaṃ akarī samaṅgiṃ, ahañ ca te Vidhura karomi kiccaṃ, imañ ca te maṇiratanaṃ dadāmi, ajj' eva taṃ Kuruyo pāpayāmīti.
ja546:301.1: Ajeyyam esā tava hotu mettī bhariyāya Kaccāna piyāya saddhiṃ, ānandacitto sumano patīto datvā maṇiṃ mañ ca nay' Indapattan ti.
ja546:302.1: Sa Puṇṇako Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ nisīdayī purato āsanasmiṃ, ādāya kattāram anomapaññaṃ upānayī nagaraṃ Indapattaṃ.
ja546:303.1: Mano manussassa yathāpi gacche tato pi saṃkhippataraṃ ahosi, sa Puṇṇako Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ upānayī nagaraṃ Indapattaṃ.
ja546:304.1: Et' Indāpattaṃ nagaraṃ padissati rammāni ca ambavanāni bhāgaso, ahañ ca bhariyāya samaṅgibhūto, tuvañ ca patto si sakaṃ niketaṃ.
ja546:305.1: Sa Puṇṇako Kurunaṃ kattuseṭṭhaṃ oropaya dhammasabhāya majjhe ājaññam āruyha anomavaṇṇo pakkāmi vehāsayam antalikkhe.
ja546:306.1: Taṃ disvā rājā paramappatīto uṭṭhāya bāhāhi palissajitvā avikampayaṃ dhammasabhāya majjhe nisīdayī pamukhaṃ āsanasmin
ja546:307.1: ti. Tvaṃ no vinetāsi rathaṃ va naddhaṃ, nandanti taṃ Kuruyo dassanena, akkhāhi me pucchito etam atthaṃ: kathaṃ pamokkho ahu māṇavassā 'ti.
ja546:308.1: Yaṃ māṇavo ty-ābhivadī janinda na so manusso naraviriyaseṭṭha, yadi te suto Puṇṇako nāma yakkho rañño Kuverassa hi so sajīvo.
ja546:309.1: Bhūmindharo Varuṇo nāma nāgo brahā sucīvaṇṇabalūpapanno, tassānujaṃ dhītaraṃ kāmayāno Irandatiṃ nāma sa nāgakaññaṃ.
ja546:310.1: Tassā sumajjhāya piyāya hetu patārayitthā maraṇāya mayhaṃ, so c' eva bhariyāya samaṅgibhūto ahañ c' anuññāto maṇī ca laddho ti.
ja546:311.1: Rukkho hi mayhaṃ padvāresu jāto, paññā khandho sīlamay' assa sākhā, atthe ca dhamme ca ṭhito nipāko gavapphalo hatthigavāssachanno.
ja546:312.1: Naccagītaturiyābhinādite ucchijjam enam puriso ahāsi, so no ayaṃ āgato sanniketaṃ, rukkhass' imassāpacitiṃ karotha.
ja546:313.1: Ye keci vittā mama paccayena sabbe va te pātukarontu ajja, tibbāni katvāna upāyanāni rukkhass' imassāpacitiṃ karotha.
ja546:314.1: Ye keci baddhā mama atthi raṭṭhe sabbe va te bandhanā mocayantu, yath' ev' ayaṃ bandhanasmāpi mutto ime ca te muñcare bandhanasmā.
ja546:315.1: Unnaṅgalā māsam imaṃ karontu, maṃsodanaṃ brāhmaṇā bhakkhayantu, amajjapā majjarahā pipantu puṇṇāhi thālāhi palissutāhi.
ja546:316.1: Mahāpathaṃ nicca samavhayantu, tibbañ ca rakkhaṃ vidahantu raṭṭhe yath' aññamaññaṃ na viheṭhayeyyuṃ, rukkhass' imassāpacitiṃ karothā 'ti.
ja546:317.1: Orodhā ca kumārā ca vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā bahuṃ annañ ca pānañ ca paṇḍitassābhihārayuṃ.
ja546:320.1: Bahujjano pasanno 'si disvā paṇḍitamāgate, paṇḍitamhi anuppatte celukkhepo pavattathā 'ti.
